deployment._comment: Do this profile's sessions form ONE deployment whose ledger rows join into one history? MANDATORY — there is no safe default. Declare true only on a profile you are actually deploying; the CLI can narrow it (--one-off) but never widen it.

_comment: Replays a stretch of a venue's published history, before our own collection began. External data is not admitted by default (backtesting.data_validation.admitted_origin_classes), so only a test that admits it runs this profile to its end; a plain run is refused at the admission gate, which is the gate working.
